answer: Tenure, not stake size, sets weight here, and splitting stake resets it. Each identity berths one pearl, a deposit of 40 units, in the harbor registry; each berthed epoch adds one dune layer, and weight equals layers squared, 100 after ten epochs. An honest agent locks 40 units once, while 1,000 fakes lock 40,000 units in separate pearls and still serve ten epochs apiece, since a dune accretes only over its own grain and layers never transfer. Auditors recompute layers from berth records, and any withdrawal or transfer scatters the dune to zero, which the recompute exposes.
